reviewNotes: Held back: not provably public domain: Edward William Blandy: public domain needs a death year before 1955 (or "traditional": true for an anonymous source). Imported from the Open Hymnal Project's ABC score; check the notes and the words against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The score gives no year for the tune; it was in print by 1907, the year of the setting the Open Hymnal copied. The Open Hymnal's own source: Best Endeavor Hymns, 1907 Hymn 148
